digest.component_or_area: rebar-debug skill and rebar-implement skill documentation
propositions: rebar-debug skill must attribute a confirmed defect to its originating ticket before closing the bug, using the caused_by relation and --caused-by flag on transition
The blame derivation fallback misattributes defects when the fix site is not the cause site, such as when a producer ships an unmet obligation and a consumer code remains unchanged

rebar-debug skill must detect and handle the unmet-obligation case via date comparison (implicated lines predate good-to-bad transition) and producer-side history search before falling back to unattributable

The caused_by link must be supplied via --caused-by on bug close even if the link was already recorded via rebar link earlier, because _apply_caused_by unconditionally calls blame.derive_caused_by and adds a second guessed edge
Both rebar-debug and rebar-implement skills must bootstrap worktrees using make worktree name=<branch> instead of bare git worktree add, to provision the virtualenv and avoid pre-commit hook failures
Skills must prepend the worktree venv to PATH when running commands, per docs/local-dev-env.md, to ensure pre-commit hooks find ruff and mypy
